research.searchCoverage: Official Callingly API documentation, authentication, teams/leads/calls endpoints, Arizona/US company identity, and dated security/incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Callingly compromise found in reviewed coverage, without a breach-free claim.

Official Callingly REST API at https://api.callingly.com uses Authorization Bearer tokens created under Settings > API Keys. Operator is Callingly, headquartered in Scottsdale/Phoenix, Arizona, United States; international lead-response product, not a mainland-China edition. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Callingly compromise after distinguishing Callagy Law, Calligaris, and Callaway incidents.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Callingly security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

agents.create.description: Create a Callingly agent under a client account via POST /v1/agents. Maps to CALLINGLY_CREATE_AGENT.

account_id.description: Client account ID under which the agent will be created.

phone_number.description: Agent's phone number in E.164 format.

agents.create.title: Create agent

agents.delete.description: Permanently delete a Callingly agent via DELETE /v1/agents/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_DELETE_AGENT.

id.description: Unique identifier of the agent to delete.

account_id.description: Client account ID that the agent belongs to.

agents.delete.title: Delete agent

agents.list.description: List Callingly agents via GET /v1/agents, optionally scoped to a client account. Maps to CALLINGLY_LIST_USERS.

account_id.description: Filter users by client account ID (required for agency partners).

agents.list.title: List users

agents.schedule.get.description: Retrieve one agent's weekly availability via GET /v1/agents/{id}/schedule. Maps to CALLINGLY_GET_AGENT_SCHEDULE.

id.description: Unique identifier of the agent. Obtain this from List Users.

agents.schedule.get.title: Get agent schedule

agents.schedule.update.description: Replace an agent's weekly availability via PUT /v1/agents/{id}/schedule. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_SCHEDULE.

id.description: Unique identifier of the agent whose schedule is being updated.

schedule.description: DaySchedule objects defining weekly availability (Sunday=0 through Saturday=6).

is_available.description: Whether the agent is available this day.

agents.schedule.update.title: Update agent schedule

agents.update.description: Update an existing agent's details via PUT /v1/agents/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_AGENT.

id.description: Unique identifier of the agent to update.

account_id.description: Client account ID under which the agent exists.

phone_number.description: Agent's phone number, in E.164 or local format.

donotdisturb.description: Do-not-disturb flag: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

donotdisturb_until.description: Datetime until which do-not-disturb is active, required if donotdisturb=1.

agents.update.title: Update agent

calls.create.description: Create a Callingly outbound call from lead details via POST /v1/calls. Maps to CALLINGLY_CREATE_CALL. Initiates a real call.

account_id.description: Callingly account ID. Retrieve this using List Teams.

team_id.description: Team that will handle the call. Must belong to account_id.

phone_number.description: Lead's phone number in E.164 format.

source.description: Source where the lead originated from.

crm_id.description: External CRM identifier for the lead.

scheduled_at.description: Optional scheduled timestamp for the call.

calls.create.title: Create outbound call

calls.get.description: Retrieve one Callingly call by ID via GET /v1/calls/{call_id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_GET_CALL.

call_id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the call. Obtain this from List Calls.

calls.get.title: Get call

calls.list.description: List Callingly calls via GET /v1/calls with optional date, team, and pagination filters. Maps to CALLINGLY_LIST_CALLS.
calls.list.title: List calls

clients.activate.description: Activate or deactivate a client account via POST /v1/clients/{id}/active. Maps to CALLINGLY_ACTIVATE_DEACTIVATE_CLIENT.

client_id.description: Unique identifier of the client account to modify.

is_active.description: Set to 1 to activate the client account or 0 to deactivate it.

clients.activate.title: Activate or deactivate client

clients.create.description: Create a client sub-account via POST /v1/clients. Maps to CALLINGLY_CREATE_CLIENT.

phone_number.description: Client's phone number in E.164 format.

clients.create.title: Create client

clients.delete.description: Delete a client account via DELETE /v1/clients/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_DELETE_CLIENT.

id.description: Positive integer ID of the client to delete.

clients.delete.title: Delete client

clients.list.description: List clients associated with the authenticated account via GET /v1/clients. Maps to CALLINGLY_LIST_CLIENTS.
clients.list.title: List clients

leads.delete.description: Permanently delete a lead via DELETE /v1/leads/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_DELETE_LEAD.

id.description: Positive integer ID of the lead to delete.

leads.delete.title: Delete lead

leads.update.description: Update an existing lead via PUT /v1/leads/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_LEAD.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lead to update.

company.description: Company name associated with the lead.

is_blocked.description: Flag to block the lead: 1 to block, 0 to unblock.

is_stopped.description: Flag to stop automated calls: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the lead in E.164 format.

leads.update.title: Update lead

teams.agents.list.description: List agents assigned to a team via GET /v1/teams/{id}/agents. Maps to CALLINGLY_LIST_TEAM_USERS.

id.description: Unique numeric ID of the team. Use List Teams to retrieve team IDs.

teams.agents.list.title: List team users

teams.agents.remove.description: Remove an agent from a team via DELETE /v1/teams/{team_id}/agents/{agent_id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_REMOVE_TEAM_AGENT.

team_id.description: Unique identifier of the team to remove the agent from.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent to remove from the team.

teams.agents.remove.title: Remove team agent

teams.agents.update.description: Replace the agents assigned to a team via PUT /v1/teams/{id}/agents. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_TEAM_USERS.

id.description: Unique identifier of the team to update.

agents.description: Agent IDs to assign. Replaces all current agents. Empty list removes all.

teams.agents.update.title: Update team users

teams.agents.update_settings.description: Update priority and capacity for one team agent via PUT /v1/teams/{team_id}/agents/{agent_id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_TEAM_AGENT_SETTINGS.

team_id.description: Unique identifier of the team containing the agent.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent whose settings to update.

cap.description: Maximum number of calls the agent can receive.

teams.agents.update_settings.title: Update team agent settings

teams.create.description: Create a Callingly team via POST /v1/teams. Maps to CALLINGLY_CREATE_TEAM.

account_id.description: Account ID under which to create the team.

delay.description: Delay in seconds before dialing team members.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts per agent.

is_retry.description: Enable per-agent retries: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

language.description: Language code for team messages (e.g. en).

call_mode.description: Call distribution mode. Only simultaneous is supported currently.

is_record.description: Whether calls should be recorded: 1 to record, 0 otherwise.

lead_retries.description: Number of retries at the lead level.

is_reschedule.description: Enable rescheduling on no-answer: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

is_retry_lead.description: Enable lead-level retries: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

retry_schedule.description: Schedule for per-agent retries in minutes.

lead_retry_schedule.description: Schedule for lead-level retries in minutes.

teams.create.title: Create team

webhooks.create.description: Create a Callingly webhook for call or lead events via POST /v1/webhooks. Maps to CALLINGLY_CREATE_WEBHOOK. Outbound registration, not an inbound AppCall trigger.

name.description: A descriptive name for the webhook.

target_url.description: The callback URL to receive the webhook.

field.description: For lead_created or lead_updated: field to watch for changes.

filter.description: For lead_created or lead_updated: value the watched field must match.

team_id.description: For outbound call_completed events: team ID to filter on.

direction.description: For call_completed events: outbound or inbound.

number_id.description: For inbound call_completed events: number ID to filter on.

call_lead_status.description: For call_completed events: lead outcome filter.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook

webhooks.delete.description: Delete a webhook via DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_DELETE_WEBHOOK.

id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to delete.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook

webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one webhook via GET /v1/webhooks/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_GET_WEBHOOK.

id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to retrieve.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook

webhooks.list.description: List configured webhooks via GET /v1/webhooks. Maps to CALLINGLY_LIST_WEBHOOKS.

account_id.description: Filter webhooks by client account ID (required for agency partners).

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks

webhooks.update.description: Partially update a webhook via PUT /v1/webhooks/{id}. Maps to CALLINGLY_UPDATE_WEBHOOK.

id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to update.

name.description: New descriptive name for the webhook.

event.description: Event type that triggers the webhook.

field.description: For lead_created/lead_updated: the lead field to watch.

filter.description: For lead_created/lead_updated: value the watched field must match.

team_id.description: For outbound call_completed events: filter by team ID.

number_id.description: For inbound call_completed events: filter by number ID.

target_url.description: New callback URL to receive webhook payloads.

call_status.description: For call_completed events: filter by call status.

call_direction.description: For call_completed events: filter by call direction.

call_lead_status.description: For call_completed events: filter by lead outcome.
